主要内容: PSP Investments reported strong performance in fiscal year 2018, ending March 31, 2018, with net assets of $153.0 billion, an increase of 12.9% compared to the previous fiscal year of $135.6 billion. The one-year total portfolio net return was 9.8%, generating $13.5 billion of net income, net of all PSP costs. This return was significantly greater than the Policy Portfolio benchmark return of 8.7%. The five-year annualized net return was 10.5%, 1.1% above the benchmark, while the ten-year net annualized return was 7.1%, generating $23.8 billion of cumulative net investment gains above the return objective of 5.8%. Net assets increased by $17.4 billion in fiscal year 2018, attributable to net income of $13.5 billion and net contributions of $3.9 billion. All asset classes saw strong returns, with Infrastructure leading at 19.3% one-year return, followed by Real Estate at 13.6%, Private Equity at 12.9%, and Public Markets at 8.3%. The company generated $2.3 billion in investment income, resulting in a 19.3% one-year return, outperforming the benchmark return of 12.1%. During the fiscal year, the group deployed $3.3 billion, including $2.2 billion in direct investments. Private Debt had net assets under management of $8.9 billion, up from $4.4 billion the previous year, and generated $569 million in net investment income, yielding an 8.2% one-year return, compared to a benchmark of 2.3%. Natural Resources had net assets under management of $4.8 billion, an increase of $1.1 billion from the previous year, and generated record investment income of $450 million, for a one-year return of 11.2%, versus the 3.1% benchmark. The group also made significant progress in diversifying its investments into the agriculture sector, which now account for $2 billion of assets under management. Neil Cunningham was appointed President and CEO on February 7, 2018, and the company launched its new brand, Spot the Edge, emphasizing its commitment to exploring opportunities across asset classes, markets, and industries.
